import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientEpimorphism
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.SchemeMorphismDescent

/-!
# Geometric quotients and invariant morphisms

Quotient topology, orbit fibres, and the invariant structure sheaf imply the
universal property for maps to schemes. The sheaf condition is expressed on
all opens here; no factorization property is assumed in the definition.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (act : G →* Aut X)

/-- An orbit quotient whose structure sheaf is the invariant subsheaf of the
source structure sheaf. Finiteness and existence are separate assertions. -/
structure IsGeometricQuotient (q : X ⟶ Y) : Prop where
  invariant : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ q = q
  isQuotientMap : Topology.IsQuotientMap q
  eq_iff : ∀ x y : X, q x = q y ↔ ∃ g : G, (act g).hom x = y
  app_injective : ∀ U : Y.Opens, Function.Injective (q.app U)
  mem_range_app : ∀ (U : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
    s ∈ Set.range (q.app U) ↔
      ∀ g : G, (actApp act (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q invariant U) g).hom s = s

/-- Build the all-open geometric quotient interface from the affine-open
conditions used in Milne I.8.10. -/
theorem IsGeometricQuotient.of_affineOpen (q : X ⟶ Y)
    (hinv : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ q = q)
    (hquot : Topology.IsQuotientMap q)
    (horbit : ∀ x y : X, q x = q y ↔ ∃ g : G, (act g).hom x = y)
    (hinj : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → Function.Injective (q.app U).hom)
    (hfixed : ∀ (U : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
      ∀ s : Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ U),
        s ∈ Set.range (q.app U).hom ↔
          ∀ g : G, (actApp act
            (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hinv U) g).hom s = s) :
    IsGeometricQuotient act q :=
  { invariant := hinv
    isQuotientMap := hquot
    eq_iff := horbit
    app_injective := fun U => app_injective_of_affineOpen q hinj U
    mem_range_app := fun U s =>
      mem_range_app_iff_actApp_of_affineOpen act q hinv hinj hfixed U s }

namespace IsGeometricQuotient

variable {act} {q : X ⟶ Y} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)

include hq in
theorem epi : Epi q := by
  apply epi_of_surjective_of_app_injective q
    (Topology.IsQuotientMap.surjective hq.isQuotientMap) hq.app_injective

variable (f : X ⟶ Z) (hf : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ f = f)

/-- Descend the continuous map using the orbit fibres. -/
noncomputable def factorBase : Y.toTopCat ⟶ Z.toTopCat :=
  TopCat.ofHom (hq.isQuotientMap.lift f.base.hom (by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := (hq.eq_iff x y).mp hxy
    exact (congrArg (fun t : X ⟶ Z => t x) (hf g)).symm))

theorem factorBase_comp : q.base ≫ hq.factorBase f hf = f.base := by
  apply TopCat.hom_ext
  exact hq.isQuotientMap.lift_comp f.base.hom _

theorem factorBase_preimage (U : Z.Opens) :
    q ⁻¹ᵁ (Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U = f ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
  change (Opens.map (q.base ≫ hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U = _
  rw [factorBase_comp]
  rfl

noncomputable def factorPullback (U : Z.Opens) :
    Γ(Z, U) ⟶ Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ (Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U) :=
  f.appLE U _ (hq.factorBase_preimage f hf U).le

theorem factorPullback_invariant (U : Z.Opens) (g : G) :
    hq.factorPullback f hf U ≫ actApp act
      (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant _) g =
        hq.factorPullback f hf U := by
  rw [factorPullback, actApp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, appLE_congr_hom (hf g)]

theorem factorPullback_mem_range (U : Z.Opens) (s : Γ(Z, U)) :
    (hq.factorPullback f hf U).hom s ∈
      Set.range (q.app ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U)) := by
  apply (hq.mem_range_app _ _).mpr
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun t => t.hom s) (hq.factorPullback_invariant f hf U g)

/-- Descend pullback of sections through the invariant subsheaf. -/
noncomputable def factorApp (U : Z.Opens) :
    Γ(Z, U) ⟶ Γ(Y, (Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U) := by
  let r := (q.app ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U)).hom
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective r.rangeRestrict
    ⟨fun a b hab => hq.app_injective _ (congrArg Subtype.val hab),
      r.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  exact CommRingCat.ofHom (e.symm.toRingHom.comp
    ((hq.factorPullback f hf U).hom.codRestrict r.range
      (hq.factorPullback_mem_range f hf U)))

theorem factorApp_comp (U : Z.Opens) :
    hq.factorApp f hf U ≫ q.app ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U) =
      hq.factorPullback f hf U := by
  let r := (q.app ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U)).hom
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective r.rangeRestrict
    ⟨fun a b hab => hq.app_injective _ (congrArg Subtype.val hab),
      r.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  ext s
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply
    ⟨_, hq.factorPullback_mem_range f hf U s⟩)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem factorApp_naturality {U V : Z.Opens} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    Z.presheaf.map i.op ≫ hq.factorApp f hf U =
      hq.factorApp f hf V ≫ Y.presheaf.map ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).map i).op := by
  let b := hq.factorBase f hf
  haveI : Mono (q.app ((Opens.map b).obj U)) :=
    ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ (hq.app_injective _)
  apply (cancel_mono (q.app ((Opens.map b).obj U))).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, factorApp_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, q.naturality (((Opens.map b).map i).op),
    ← Category.assoc, factorApp_comp]
  dsimp [factorPullback]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]

noncomputable def factorPresheafedSpace : Y.toPresheafedSpace ⟶ Z.toPresheafedSpace where
  base := hq.factorBase f hf
  c :=
    { app := fun U => hq.factorApp f hf U.unop
      naturality := fun _ _ i => hq.factorApp_naturality f hf i.unop }

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem factorPresheafedSpace_comp :
    q.toLRSHom.toHom ≫ hq.factorPresheafedSpace f hf = f.toLRSHom.toHom := by
  apply PresheafedSpace.ext _ _ (hq.factorBase_comp f hf)
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext U
  change (hq.factorApp f hf U.unop ≫
      q.app ((Opens.map (hq.factorBase f hf)).obj U.unop)) ≫ _ = f.app U.unop
  rw [factorApp_comp]
  dsimp [factorPullback]
  change f.appLE _ _ _ ≫ X.presheaf.map _ = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app f

/-- An invariant morphism descends through a geometric quotient. -/
noncomputable def factor : Y ⟶ Z :=
  schemeMorphismOfPresheafedSpaceFactor q
    (Topology.IsQuotientMap.surjective hq.isQuotientMap) f
    (hq.factorPresheafedSpace f hf) (hq.factorPresheafedSpace_comp f hf)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem comp_factor : q ≫ hq.factor f hf = f :=
  comp_schemeMorphismOfPresheafedSpaceFactor _ _ _ _ _

include hq hf in
/-- The invariant structure sheaf and quotient topology imply the universal
property for morphisms into arbitrary schemes. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor : ∃! u : Y ⟶ Z, q ≫ u = f := by
  letI := epi hq
  refine ⟨hq.factor f hf, hq.comp_factor f hf, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  exact (cancel_epi q).mp (hv.trans (hq.comp_factor f hf).symm)

variable {f hf}

/-- Two geometric quotients of the same action are canonically isomorphic. -/
noncomputable def iso {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q') : Y ≅ Z where
  hom := hq.factor q' hq'.invariant
  inv := hq'.factor q hq.invariant
  hom_inv_id := by
    letI := epi hq
    apply (cancel_epi q).mp
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_factor, Category.comp_id]
  inv_hom_id := by
    letI := epi hq'
    apply (cancel_epi q').mp
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_factor, Category.comp_id]

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem comp_iso_hom {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q') :
    q ≫ (hq.iso hq').hom = q' :=
  hq.comp_factor q' hq'.invariant

include hq in
/-- The isomorphism commuting with the two quotient projections is unique. -/
theorem existsUnique_iso {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q') :
    ∃! e : Y ≅ Z, q ≫ e.hom = q' := by
  letI := epi hq
  refine ⟨hq.iso hq', hq.comp_iso_hom hq', ?_⟩
  intro e he
  apply Iso.ext
  exact (cancel_epi q).mp (he.trans (hq.comp_iso_hom hq').symm)

end IsGeometricQuotient
end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
